premises.text: Reality-TV post-production is extremely labor-intensive relative to finished runtime
premises.evidence_span: one minute of the final product takes up to 17 hours of post-production

premises.text: Teams currently coordinate post via email threads, calendars, calls, and spreadsheets
premises.evidence_span: sifting through emails with long threads where someone hits reply all, scheduling meetings on calendars, long phone calls with people in multiple time zones

premises.text: A viewing room focuses stakeholders on the video with timestamped comments
premises.evidence_span: the viewing room is the sole focus is on the video itself and to give feedback on it

premises.text: Timestamped feedback can be assigned and exported as markers into editors' NLEs
premises.evidence_span: export it directly into his favorite video editing software

premises.text: Browser-based design that uses existing hosting eases IT adoption
premises.evidence_span: IT departments specifically love us because it's browser-based, and we leverage existing hosting infrastructure

premises.text: Project-based pricing is affordable for small teams while producing upside for larger clients
premises.evidence_span: project based pricing that's friendly to teams of all sizes

premises.text: Native Adobe integration and MPAA standards unlock Hollywood studio workflows
premises.evidence_span: we're announcing our native integration with Adobe

domains.name: Browser IT adoption and project pricing

value.text: Video professionals collaborate and manage post-production without email-driven chaos
value.evidence_span: a communication and project management tool for video professionals
